recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a group of men in early 90s urban fashion against a textured red backdrop, bisected by a horizontal yellow band and a lower section of abstract, colorful textile patterns. The design uses bold, overlapping geometric typography that interacts with the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects in the upper half are anchored by a horizontal yellow bar.
Typography overlaps the central figures, creating depth.
The lower third mirrors the upper half's complexity with high-contrast abstract patterns.
A vertical axis is established by the stem of a large character extending into the bottom frame.
coreInvariants: Warm red textured background for the portrait section.
Horizontal yellow divider bar containing secondary text.
High-contrast, eclectic patterns on clothing and in the bottom panel.
Muted lavender/periwinkle color for primary display type.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six men arranged horizontally across the upper two-thirds, varying in pose from front-facing to profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, stylized geometric letter 'T' that acts as a vertical spine for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central group, follow the large lavender letters downward to the yellow bar, then drop to the patterned base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures, patterns, and large-scale type.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale yellow (horizontal bar) and periwinkle (primary type).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal (bottom border) and multi-color abstract patterns (bottom panel).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red background and patterns, contrasted by the flat, matte pastel tones of the graphic overlays.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and wide blocky sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary display letters are oversized and tilted at dynamic angles.
Secondary text is wide, all-caps, and heavily tracked.
Vertical text is rotated 90 degrees and aligned to a graphic stem.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'i' is lowercase and blocky, acting as a bridge between larger uppercase letters.
The letter 'T' has an elongated stem that pierces through the horizontal divider.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric display type paired with ultra-wide, tracked-out secondary sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric foundation for the large display type.
Matches the wide, technical feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group portrait of six men in 90s fashion (patterned shirts, hats, blazers) against a red textured wall. The bottom third of the image features a vibrant, abstract textile pattern with organic shapes. A solid yellow horizontal bar separates the two sections.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, overlapping periwinkle geometric letters in the center. Place wide-tracked all-caps text inside the yellow bar. Extend a vertical element from the main type down through the bottom section.

verificationChecks: Does the large type overlap the subjects?
Is the yellow bar perfectly horizontal?
Is the secondary text ultra-wide and all-caps?
Is the bottom section filled with abstract patterns?

adjustableVariables: Pattern complexity in the bottom panel
Number of subjects in the portrait
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Original brand logos or specific shirt patterns
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Flat, graphic quality of the overlays
Dynamic overlapping of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the periwinkle color is matte and flat.
Check that the 'T' stem aligns with the vertical text below it.
Verify the 90s fashion aesthetic is maintained in the clothing.
Confirm the red background has a subtle texture like a curtain or wall.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a group portrait against a textured primary color background with a horizontal divider bar, then overlay oversized, tilted geometric sans-serif type that breaks the frame boundaries.
